business_problem: In healthcare, no two patients are exactly alike. Therefore, providing the most valuable care requires a deep understanding of patients, their health concerns, and their goals.
solution_summary: Reveleer uses Google Gemini and Vertex AI to build a next-generation, AI-powered prospective risk adjustment solution that gives doctors the information they need to help patients at the point of care. One of the highlights of the Reveleer platform is its prospective risk adjustment solution. The hybrid AI-powered solution extracts and analyzes both structured and unstructured data from electronic health records, lab reports, doctor's notes, and prescriptions from various data sources. It then delivers provable, explainable, audit-ready insights directly into a physician's workflow, reducing provider abrasion and improving the patient experience and outcome. Reveleer started its search for the right LLM with Vertex AI. Developers started experimenting with top first-party, third-party, and open source models through Model Garden on Vertex AI.
